definition_zh: n. 枯萎病；祸害；破坏……的因素；v. 使枯萎；摧残
definition_en: a disease that withers plants, or anything that spoils and destroys
core_image: 一夜之间枯黑成片的马铃薯田
scene: 农人跪在田埂上，抓起一把枯黑的薯叶。The potato blight destroyed the harvest of 1845.
sceneCN: 这里 blight 是名词「枯萎病」（第 1 个义项：使植物迅速枯死的病害）；句意是马铃薯枯萎病毁掉了 1845 年的收成。

derivatives.zh: blight 加 -ed，义为「枯萎的；被摧毁的」

senses.title: A plant disease causing withering
senses.definition: a fungal or bacterial disease that quickly withers plants
senses.definitionCN: 使植物迅速枯死的真菌或细菌病害
senses.example: The potato blight destroyed the harvest of 1845.
senses.exampleCN: 马铃薯枯萎病毁掉了 1845 年的收成。
senses.why: The old word named the sudden blackening blast that hits leaves overnight.
senses.whyCN: 古词本指一夜之间令叶片发黑枯死的「暴损」。

senses.title: Anything that withers growth
senses.definition: any force that checks growth and ruins healthy development
senses.definitionCN: 抑制生长、破坏健康发展的力量
senses.example: War was a blight on a whole generation's hopes.
senses.exampleCN: 战争摧残了一整代人的希望。
senses.why: What kills leaves can, by metaphor, kill futures.
senses.whyCN: 令叶枯死者，经隐喻亦能令未来枯萎。

senses.title: Decay in towns and neighbourhoods
senses.definition: deterioration of buildings and districts into neglect and ruin
senses.definitionCN: 建筑与街区沦为失修荒废的状态
senses.example: Vacant lots spread blight across the district.
senses.exampleCN: 空置地块让衰败蔓延至整个街区。
senses.why: Districts, like plants, seem to rot from one abandoned corner outward.
senses.whyCN: 街区如植物，似乎从一个被弃的角落向外腐烂。

senses.title: To wither plants or hopes
senses.definition: to cause to wither, decay, or fail
senses.example: Frost blighted the young shoots in a single night.
senses.exampleCN: 一夜寒霜令嫩芽尽数枯萎。
senses.why: The noun made a verb: what blight does, to blight does too.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词：枯萎病之所为，即 blight 动词之所为。

senses.title: To spoil an otherwise good thing
senses.definition: to damage something good so it can never be enjoyed fully
senses.definitionCN: 损坏美好之物使其再不能被完整享有
senses.example: His early failure blighted an otherwise brilliant career.
senses.exampleCN: 早年的一次失败毁损了他本可辉煌的职业生涯。
senses.why: One withered branch tells on the whole tree.

senses.title: A persistent source of misery
senses.definition: a continuing trouble that blights a place or people
senses.definitionCN: 长期祸害某地或某群体的顽疾
senses.example: Corruption remained the blight of the province.
senses.exampleCN: 腐败始终是该省的顽疾。
senses.why: Blight is not one storm but a condition, hence its long-term uses.
senses.whyCN: 枯萎病非一场风暴而是一种状态，故有长期之用。

senses.title: To condemn buildings or land
senses.definition: to officially declare property unfit or scheduled for clearance
senses.definitionCN: 官方宣布房产不宜居住或列入清拆
senses.example: Whole blocks were blighted for the new motorway.
senses.exampleCN: 整片街区被认定为新高速公路的清拆范围。
senses.why: Once named diseased, a district loses value as if it truly sickened.
senses.whyCN: 一旦被认定为「病区」，街区便如真的染病般贬值。

senses.title: A withering personal influence
senses.definition: a person or atmosphere that crushes joy and growth around it
senses.definitionCN: 压制周围欢乐与成长的人或氛围
senses.example: His cold criticism was the blight of the studio.
senses.exampleCN: 他冰冷的批评是整间工作室的毒氛。
senses.why: People, like climates, can frost what grows near them.
senses.whyCN: 人如气候，也能冻伤身边生长之物。

intro.en: Blight's origin is uncertain; it appeared in the 17th century for sudden crop damage.
intro.cn: blight 词源不确定，17 世纪指作物突发的损害。

items.en: first recorded in early 17th-century English; perhaps related to blast or to a Saxon word for heat or plague.
items.cn: 首见于 17 世纪初英语，或与 blast 相关，或与表示「热气、瘟疫」的撒克逊词有关，来源不确定。

items.en: named the sudden, invisible injury that blackened leaves and grain.
items.cn: 指使叶片与谷物发黑的突发无形之害。

items.en: established in farming speech for blights of wheat, potatoes, and apples.
items.cn: 在农业用语中确立，指麦、马铃薯、苹果的病害。

items.en: the potato blight of the 1840s fixed the word in world memory.
items.cn: 19 世纪 40 年代的爱尔兰马铃薯枯萎病使此词举世皆知。

items.en: now covers urban decay and any crushing force on life.
items.cn: 今泛指城市衰败及一切摧残生机之力。

note.en: Blight stands alone in English; look-alikes are sound twins, near-meanings are ruin words.
note.cn: blight 在英语中别无同族词；形近组为音近词，近义组为摧残类词。

entries.definitionCN: 光；轻的——拼写相近，词义相反
飞行——拼写相近，词源不同
爆炸；枯萎之气——形近义相关
植物暴损——古旧农事用语

normalIntro.en: Blight is the farmer's word for the withering curse on crops.
normalIntro.cn: blight 是农人形容作物枯萎祸害的词。

normal.en: Urban blight is a fixed phrase.
normal.cn: urban blight 是固定搭配，指城市衰败。

normal.en: The verb means to wither or spoil.
normal.cn: 动词义为使枯萎或毁损。
马铃薯晚疫病改变了爱尔兰历史。

normal.en: Blighted describes ruined lives and areas.
normal.cn: blighted 形容被毁的人生与街区。

normal.en: It is stronger than harm and darker than damage.
normal.cn: 它比 harm 更重，比 damage 更暗。

abstract.en: See green leaves turn black at the edges by morning.
abstract.cn: 看绿叶一夜之间边缘发黑。

abstract.en: Feel hope drying like a leaf in your hand.
abstract.cn: 感受希望如掌中之叶般枯干。

abstract.en: Picture one abandoned house pulling down a whole street.
abstract.cn: 想象一栋弃屋拖垮整条街。

examples.en: The potato blight destroyed the harvest of 1845.
examples.cn: 马铃薯枯萎病毁掉了 1845 年的收成。

examples.en: Frost blighted the young shoots in a single night.
examples.cn: 一夜寒霜令嫩芽尽数枯萎。

examples.en: Vacant lots spread blight across the district.
examples.cn: 空置地块让衰败蔓延至整个街区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不来嗑」——庄稼染了枯萎病，麻雀都不来嗑一粒，整田尽毁。

root: 词源不确定：首见于 17 世纪初英语，或与 blast「枯萎之气」相关，或出自表示「热气、瘟疫」的撒克逊词（一般认为存疑）；先指作物突发枯损，后扩指城市衰败及一切摧残生机之力。

sensesIntro.en: From blackened potato leaves to ruined streets and hopes, blight names any force that withers the living.
sensesIntro.cn: 从发黑的薯叶到破败的街道与破灭的希望，blight 指一切令生者枯萎的力量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a potato field blackened overnight
core.cn: 核心意象：一夜枯黑的马铃薯田

branches.cn: 实指的植物病害与枯萎
衰败街区与被认定清拆之地

branches.en: Forces that ruin growth and joy
branches.cn: 摧残生机与欢乐的力量

branches.en: People who frost those around them
One failure that stains a whole career
branches.cn: 玷污整个职业生涯的一次失败

intro.en: Blight is a lone English word with few relatives.
intro.cn: blight 是孤独的英语词，同族词极少。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root; Germanic surroundings only.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁词根，仅日耳曼周边词。
